# Fluixi Forms

> @fluixi/forms is the form library for Fluixi: every field is its own reactive cell, with sync and
> async validation, groups, arrays, and schema validators (Standard Schema, Zod, Valibot).

@fluixi/forms is experimental: APIs change between alpha releases. Code remembered from an older
alpha may no longer compile; check it against these rules and the installed version, and pin exact
versions.

The framework rules come first: https://docs.fluixi.com/llms.txt. For the form components
(`Form`, `FormField`, inputs), read https://ui.fluixi.com/llms.txt.

## Rules for writing forms

### State and validation

- Build the form with `createForm({ ... })` and `createField(initial, { validators })`, imported
  from `@fluixi/forms`. Do not hold form state in hand-made signals.
- Validate with a schema: `standardValidator(schema)` takes any Standard Schema (Zod 4, Valibot,
  ArkType), on a field or on the whole form; its first issue becomes the error. An async schema
  goes in `asyncValidators` through `standardAsyncValidator(schema)`. `fromZod(schema)` builds a
  typed form from a Zod object, one field per key.
- Built-in validators: `required()`, `email()`, `minLength(n)`, `sameAs('otherField', message)`.
- Async validators take `(value, ctx, signal)`; pass `signal` to `fetch` so a stale check is
  aborted. `debounce: 300` on the field spaces them out; `field.pending()` is true while one runs.
- Reads are signals: `form.get('email').value()`, `.valid()`, `.error()`, `.touched()`;
  `form.valid()` for the whole form.
- `field.setValue(v)` marks the field touched, so its error shows at once. To prefill or clear a
  form, use `field.reset(v)`.
- `createField` widens a literal start value: `createField('fr')` is a `string` field. Narrow at
  submit.
- Lists of fields: `createFormArray([...])` with `push`, `move`, `removeAt`.
- Schemas live with the app's shared types, not in the route file. Messages are i18n keys,
  translated where they are shown.

### Rendering and submitting

- Render with `Form` and `FormField` from `@fluixi-ui/form`, and the inputs from `@fluixi-ui/*`:

```tsx
<Form form={form} action={signUp} novalidate>
  <FormField control={form.get('email')} label="Email">
    {(b) => <Input type="email" name="email" value={b.value()} onInput={b.onInput} onBlur={b.onBlur} />}
  </FormField>
</Form>
```

- `Form` validates first, then calls its `action` (a router `action(fn, 'name')`) with the checked
  values only, and keeps `method="post"` and the action URL so the form also works without
  script. Use `onSubmit` for a plain async function. Read pending and error state with
  `useSubmission`.
- The router's `ActionForm` posts the fields as they are, unchecked: use it only when nothing
  needs validating.
- Without fluixi-ui, `Field` and `bindField` from `@fluixi/forms` give the same bindings
  (`value`, `onInput`, `onBlur`, `aria-invalid`).
- A server refusal is thrown as an i18n key (`new Error('auth.error.tooMany')`) and shown like a
  validation error.
